title: Linear threshold junta size bound
statement: Let $B,\varepsilon,\eta\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $1\le B$ and $0<\varepsilon,\eta\le 1/2$. For every $k\in\mathbb N$ with $k\le B/\varepsilon^2$, we have $\dfrac{1}{\bigl(\varepsilon(\eta/(2+\eta))^k\bigr)^{1+\eta}}\le (1/\eta)^{200B/\varepsilon^2}$.
replaced: Let $B\ge1$, $0<\varepsilon,\eta\le1/2$, and $k\in\mathbb N$ with $k\le B/\varepsilon^2$. Then $1/(\varepsilon(\eta/(2+\eta))^k)^{1+\eta}\le(1/\eta)^{200B/\varepsilon^2}$.
